messages:
Maria C: Quick triage — PM check-in. Current queue: 23 open, 3 new in last 2h. P1s: 1 (#455, auth failure). P2s: 4 (2 embedding errors, 1 streaming glitch, 1 billing). Noticed embedding API 500s for long documents; saw spike ~11:10 UTC. I'm on #455 now. Using macros below. Assignments: I'll take billing after auth. Any blockers?

Devon K: taking embedding errors, will dig into model variant routing. @eng-runtime FYI. Do we have a workaround? customers seeing partial responses.

Lia T: For customers, use macro `ack-emb-issue` then `embed-ttl-suggest` (short doc chunking). Can we paste macros? :point_down: 

Samir P: here's the quick macros to use:
```
ack-emb-issue:
Hi — thanks for reporting this. We're investigating an upstream embeddings issue causing 500s for long inputs. Temporary workaround: split inputs into <5k tokens or reduce batch size. We'll follow up with ETA.

embed-ttl-suggest:
If you'd like, I can proactively chunk your documents and re-run embeddings for free while we investigate.
```
Use `ack-emb-issue` first, then `embed-ttl-suggest` if they ask for help. I'm updating macros repo.

triage-bot: Ticket #467 auto-assigned to Devon K (rule: embeddings-errors).

Alex R: ping @Devon for logs — if you need a quick kernel restart, check `svc/embeddings` restart script: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/redwood-embeddings` — do we have rollbacks queued?

Devon K: got logs, seeing `kv cache OOM` on node gpx3-4. Restarting instance (rolling). Will monitor for 10m.

Lia T: Reminder to use `ack-p1` macro for P1s:
```
ack-p1:
Thanks for raising this. We're treating this with highest priority. An engineer is assigned and we'll provide updates every 15 minutes. Can you share request id / sample payload?
```

Maria C: thanks. Next steps:
- Devon: continue embedding fix + monitor (I'll coordinate customer comms)
- Samir: keep macros updated; push to snippets
- Alex: standby for kernel restarts
- Lia: cover billing P2
I'll post another status in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
